global_indexing.rng_rule: For species index s in [0,1,2] and global permutation index k, initialize numpy default_rng with SeedSequence([20260929,k,s]).
global_indexing.sharding: Shards partition global indices only; the permutation generated for an index is independent of shard count/order.

permutation_scheme.strata: within species x frozen V3 trait_block
permutation_scheme.outcomes: all count records, seasons, observation metadata and site identities remain attached to their original sites
permutation_scheme.refit: For every permutation refit the complete frozen V3 species model, including species-wide forcing, site drift, process SD, block intercepts and residual loadings. Observation nuisance calibration is held fixed at the real full-data calibration because it is trait-independent.

primary_statistics.paper_level: median gamma_AH across ADPE, CHPE, GEPE

multiplicity.paper_level: single preregistered primary test; no adjustment
multiplicity.species_specific: Holm adjust the three species-specific one-sided permutation p-values

computation.shard_rule: global index k assigned by contiguous partition; all 9999 unique indices covered exactly once
computation.aggregation: concatenate shard outputs, require exactly 9999 unique global indices, then compute p-values from the frozen observed point estimates

terminal_rules: No alternative permutation blocks, two-sided p-value, seed, B, species subset or fitted statistic may be substituted after results.
The paper-level conclusion is based on the cross-species median; species-specific p-values cannot replace a null paper-level result.
All three species-specific estimates and adjusted p-values are reported regardless of significance.
